item.description: Austin’s annual collision of film nerdery, industry dealmaking, and “wait, that is premiering here?” energy is locking in its first big 2026 slate. item.title: ‘Man On The Run’ Trailer: Oscar-Winner Morgan Neville Gives Paul McCartney & Wings The Doc Spotlight Treatment
item.description: How did a legendary artist move on from music’s most iconic band? “Man On The Run” chronicles Paul McCartney’s journey to become a successful solo artist. The upcoming documentary showcases the ups and downs McCartney faced as he plotted his next moves after The Beatles. He would go on to form the successful band Wings with his wife, Linda McCartney. ‘Run’ offers an in-depth and personal look at the period, featuring previously unreleased footage and rare archival materials. item.description: Some scenes can make or break a film; some of those ideas get scrapped or whittled down through the creative process, during filming, or in the editing stage. item.title: Jacob Elordi, Amy Madigan, & 46 World Premieres Set For 41st Santa Barbara Film Festival
item.description: Sundance may be right around the corner, but the 41st Santa Barbara Film Festival is dropping the week after. This year’s slate includes 46 world premieres and 80 U.S. premieres from 50 countries. Notably, 50% of films are directed by women. As always, Santa Barbara will also feature some notable panels with likely Oscar nominees hunting for votes.
